title: In-Context Multiple Instance Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.06458v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) addresses problems where supervision is available at the level of bags of instances and has been successfully applied in fields ranging from computational pathology to satellite imagery. Nevertheless, existing algorithms struggle in the low-label regime that characterizes many real-world applications. Flexible models overfit and rigid ones fail to adapt to the task at hand. We show that pretraining an in-context learner with a Perceiver-style architecture on synthetic data yields a model that can solve new tasks from a handful of labeled bags. At inference time, classification happens in a single forward pass and requires no gradient updates. We propose and investigate different synthetic data generators for bag-structured data and find that they capture complementary inductive biases. translated_abstract: 多示例学习（MIL）处理的是监督信息仅存在于实例包（bag）层面的问题，已成功应用于从计算病理学到卫星图像等多个领域。然而，现有算法在低标签场景中表现不佳，而这种低标签场景正是许多现实应用的典型特征：灵活的模型容易过拟合，而僵化的模型又无法适应手头的任务。我们证明，使用Perceiver风格架构在合成数据上预训练一个上下文学习器，可以得到一个仅需少量带标签的实例包就能解决新任务的模型。在推理阶段，分类只需一次前向传播即可完成，且无需任何梯度更新。我们提出并研究了多种针对包结构数据的合成数据生成器，发现它们能够捕捉互补的归纳偏置。在这些生成器的混合数据上预训练的模型继承了各自在不同任务上的优势，并取得了最佳的平
tldr: 该论文提出在合成数据上以Perceiver风格架构预训练上下文学习器，使模型仅需少量带标签实例包、通过一次前向传播且无需梯度更新即可解决新的多示例学习任务。
en_tdlr: This paper pretrains an in-context learner with a Perceiver-style architecture on synthetic data, enabling it to solve new multiple instance learning tasks from a handful of labeled bags via a single forward pass without any gradient updates.
